blocks.text: Jab polymer chain banane ke liye bond ya pul jaisa jor (bridging linkage) banane wale do functional groups maujood hon to condensation polymerisation hoti hai. Zyada tar polymer bante waqt monomers se aik chhota molecule nikalta hai. Dono functional groups aik hi molecule mein ho sakte hain (maslan lactic acid), ya do mukhtalif molecules mein, jaise nylon 6,6 mein.
Condensation polymerisation karne wale aam functional groups ke jore yeh hain:

items: amino group (NH₂) aur carboxylic group (COOH): polyamide aur H₂O
amino group (NH₂) aur acyl chloride (COCl): polyamide aur HCl
carboxylic group (COOH) aur alcohol (OH): polyester aur H₂O
acyl chloride (COCl) aur alcohol (OH): polyester aur HCl

blocks.text: Diye gaye monomers se banne wale polymers ki structures banayein. Har polymer ke liye batayein: (i) repeat unit, (ii) linkage ki qism, (iii) polymer chains ke darmiyan kashish ki force (attractive force).

blocks.prompt: a) 4-hydroxybenzoic acid se banne wala polymer: repeat unit, linkage aur chains ke darmiyan force?
blocks.explanation: Aik molecule ka -OH doosre ke -COOH se jurta hai aur H₂O nikalta hai, is liye polyester banta hai. Repeat unit [-O-C₆H₄-CO-]ₙ; ester linkage; chains ke darmiyan polar ester groups ki permanent dipole-dipole forces aur rings ke darmiyan van der Waals (London) forces.

blocks.prompt: b) Benzene-1,4-diamine aur cyclopentane-1,3-dicarboxylic acid se banne wala polymer: repeat unit, linkage aur chains ke darmiyan force?
blocks.explanation: -NH₂ aur -COOH jurte hain aur H₂O nikalta hai, is liye polyamide banta hai. Repeat unit [-NH-C₆H₄-NH-CO-C₅H₈-CO-]ₙ; amide linkage; aik chain ke N-H aur doosri chain ke C=O ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds, saath van der Waals forces.

items: Do reactive functional groups (aik ya do monomers mein): condensation polymerisation.
-NH₂ ke saath -COOH ya -COCl: polyamide; -OH ke saath -COOH ya -COCl: polyester.
Nikalne wala chhota molecule: acid ke saath H₂O, acyl chloride ke saath HCl.
